source.title: 10 GitHub Repos to 10x Your AI Motion Graphics

repos_mentioned.name: Lemo Opuscar
repos_mentioned.summary: 66 film styles for Claude (paper cuts, 80s anime, ink wash, retro terminal, isometric infographics). User picks style or lets Claude choose.

repos_mentioned.name: Three.js
repos_mentioned.summary: 3D graphics for the web — 3D bar charts, procedural 3D models, particle effects (galaxies), camera fly-throughs. Adds premium depth vs flat 2D.

repos_mentioned.name: PixelFX
repos_mentioned.summary: Pixel art motion graphics with built-in effect library (explosions, weather, fire, fireworks, northern lights, lightning). Supports reference-image input.

repos_mentioned.name: Blender MCP
repos_mentioned.summary: MCP server letting Claude control Blender — full 3D scenes, shaders, materials, camera animation. Professional-grade CGI used in Marvel films. One-shot prompt capable.

repos_mentioned.name: Prompt Packs (awesome-opus5-5-videos + opus-video-prompts)
repos_mentioned.summary: Collections of prompts for creating videos in specific styles using HTML, WebGL, Three.js. Mosaic effects, flat explainers, proven UI-element-driven motion.

repos_mentioned.name: Claude Animation Base
repos_mentioned.summary: Claude bot mascot ('Clawd') with built-in emotions, animation guides, timing, storyboarding. For cute explainer videos (popular on Instagram).

repos_mentioned.name: React Rapier (react-three-rapier)
repos_mentioned.summary: Real physics engine (React + Three.js). Jenga towers, domino chains, Galton boards (binomial distribution). Adds realism for science/math explainers.

repos_mentioned.name: React Postprocessing
repos_mentioned.summary: Light and post-processing effects: glow, depth of field, film grain, lens coloring, glitch. Frame-by-frame filter stack. Premium look for explainers.

repos_mentioned.name: Librosa
repos_mentioned.summary: Audio analysis — beat detection to sync motion graphics with music. Essential for product launch videos where every visual change hits on the beat.

repos_mentioned.name: Video ShotCraft
repos_mentioned.summary: 124 promo video recipes/templates for product launches. Claude selects best template and applies it. Human-created creative patterns, AI-driven execution.

author_promotions.name: Applied AI Mastermind
author_promotions.claim: AI video creation skills, software, tools, and $400k+ savings on AI tools

author_promotions.name: Skill Selector
author_promotions.claim: Selects best skill from 87+ tested for a given motion graphics request

key_insights: Claude alone produces 'AI slop' — repos add domain-specific magic dust
One-shot prompting is the workflow: paste repo URL + describe desired video
Style variety matters: 66 film styles, pixel art, 3D, physics, mascot, promo templates
Quality comes from human-curated assets (templates, styles, shaders) + AI selection/execution
Audio-visual sync (beat detection) is the hidden differentiator for premium feel
Blender MCP is the most powerful single repo — professional-grade CGI from one prompt
Post-processing (glow, DoF, grain) elevates flat renders to premium
124 promo templates make product launch videos reproducible
